_comment: Sonoran Desert typical-year rainfall, 12 monthly mm values. Source: NWS Tucson AZ, 'Tucson Monthly and Daily Normals and Records', 1991-2020 normals for TUCSON, ARIZONA (station Tucson Intl Airport area). Page: https://www.weather.gov/twc/TucsonMonthlyNormalExtremes (accessed 2026-10-25). Original units inches converted to mm (x25.4), rounded to 1 decimal. Bimodal pattern: winter frontal rains (Dec-Feb) + North American monsoon peak (Jul-Sep); foresummer drought (Apr-Jun). Representative of the Arizona Upland / Tucson-basin Sonoran typical year used by the game (D8 weather driver).
source: NWS Tucson, 1991-2020 normals (https://www.weather.gov/twc/TucsonMonthlyNormalExtremes); cross-check NOAA U.S. Climate Normals (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/us-climate-normals/)
notes: Bimodal desert rainfall: gentle winter rains Dec-Mar and intense summer monsoon Jul-Sep.
Apr-Jun is the foresummer drought: hottest/driest, highest irrigation need.
Game use: typical-year driver for weather/irrigation/water-table logic; randomized events vary around these means.
